notes:
Refers specifically to the formal process of making peace between nations or groups that have been at war. Often encountered in historical contexts, particularly regarding the San Francisco Peace Treaty ({サンフランシスコ}{講和|こうわ}{条約|じょうやく}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {講和|こうわ}{条約|じょうやく}: peace treaty
- {講和|こうわ}{交渉|こうしょう}: peace negotiations
- {講和|こうわ}{会議|かいぎ}: peace conference
- {講和|こうわ}が{成立|せいりつ}する: peace is established
- {講和|こうわ}を{結|むす}ぶ: to conclude peace

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {和平|わへい}: peace — broader term for peaceful resolution, not limited to formal treaties
- {停戦|ていせん}: ceasefire — temporary halt in fighting, not the formal end of conflict
- {平和|へいわ}: peace — general state of peace, not the process of achieving it
